purpose: Close the absent/allocated-unread/accessed and clustered/dispersed neutral sidecar exercise gap without changing any World or interpreting payload as physics.
production_carrier: unchanged PrecisionStorage uint64, size/alignment 8/8; opaque complete base bits preserved
representation: bounded optional chunk-owned split tail; no contiguous 9/10-byte residency claim
lifecycle_exercise_per_case: A separate four-chunk specimen checks explicit allocation preflight, invalid coordinates/width, high-tail preservation, copy/move/swap, synthetic split/merge, replacement/reset, reclaim and atomic refusal including injected allocation failure; compare against a dense logical reference.

operation_stream.schedule: i mod 8 selects copy, move, swap, replacement, bounded neutral split, merge, field write or read; deterministic xorshift64 chooses source/destination and bounded neutral values
operation_stream.clustered: 8192 distinct logical cells in the first storage chunk
operation_stream.dispersed: the same 8192 logical values round-robin across every resident storage chunk
operation_stream.allocated_unread: allocate two zero-filled tail chunks, perform no consumer tail read/write before recording counters
operation_stream.absent: zero tail chunks, no implicit allocation; read default zero before recording counters

accounting: actual allocated tail arrays and logical nonzero counts
sizeof/alignof base, tail element and owner object
dense eager-tail bytes at identical cell count as arithmetic only
compiler: existing LLVM-MinGW 20260826 / Clang 23.1.0 Windows toolchain retained by the prior #204 campaign; record executable hash and exact ordered argv before execution
failure_rules: Retain failed builds/cases, stop collection on unexpected exit, diagnostics, bounds, reference mismatch or accounting inconsistency. Any repaired source requires a new versioned registration and a complete fresh collection; no selective retry.
owner_scope: 2026-10-24 autonomous #204 overnight experimental completion; no merge or #212
